02 · Prompting — H3 ke liye Monarch prompt grammar
H3 ka output "prompt + soundscape + music" ke structured teen-field format par depend karta hai (H3-Context-IR isi shape me deta hai). Neeche wahi structure hai, Monarch ke locks ke saath. Optional: official skill install karo to reference guides mil jate hain — npx skills add https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3 --skill h3-prompt-writing (base-en.txt = text/keyframe modes, ref-en.txt = full-reference mode).
1. Teen modes, teen shapes
A. T2VA (sirf text → 768p/2K video + audio)
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] <style> <composition> <subject> <action> <camera>


[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to ...


overall_soundscape: <ambience + physical action sounds + breathing/efforts>


non_diegetic_music: <score only the audience hears>


Rules jo output quality banate hain:


* Pehla shot: koi timestamp nahi. Baqi shots: [Shot 2] At 00:SS.mmm, the camera cuts to ... — strictly increasing.
* Style pehli line me: Cinematic, live-action, 2D-animated, 3D CG, anime, claymation, vintage film.
* Camera = type + amplitude + speed natural sentence me: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the folded letter in her hands. (types: Zoom In/Out, Push In/Pull Out, Pan, Truck, Tilt, Pedestal, Arc Shot, Tracking Shot, Static Shot, Shake Slightly/Strongly, POV, Roll Clockwise/Counterclockwise)
* Duration description = requested duration. 5 s manga rahe ho to 3 shots na likho.
* "cinematic / beautiful / epic" jaise khaali words kam karo — concrete detail likho (lens, light, fabric, reflection).
B. I2VA / FL2VA (keyframe se shuru / first+last frame)
Pehli line fixed instruction hoti hai, phir blank line, phir wahi teen fields:


For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.


How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 3) aligns with the 5.00-second mark of the target video.


FL2VA me single shot best hota hai (model do frames ke beech interpolate karta hai), aur final [Shot N] ko exactly last frame par pohanchna hota hai.
C. Ref2VA (full-reference = Monarch face + wardrobe + voice)
Chhe sections, isi order me, labels har section me same:


Section
	Kaam
	subject_definitions
	har reference ka label + role + features
	summary
	task type + target video + reference relationships
	retention_analysis
	kaunsa item fully_preserved / partially_copy / reference / transferred
	detailed_description
	playback order me visuals, actions, camera, sound, dialogue
	overall_soundscape
	ambience + physical sounds
	non_diegetic_music
	audience-only score
	

Labels: <Subject N> (reusable visible content), <Picture N> (frame/shot anchor), <Video N> (editing source ya temporal structure), <Audio N> (voice/music reference).


Dialogue tag: <d>[Language] exact words</d> — sirf language tag + user ke asli alfaz andar; speaker ki identity, ID (S1) aur delivery tag ke bahar. Voiceover ke liye exact phrase says in an off-screen voiceover


* "his lips remain completely closed".
2. Monarch locks (har H3 shot me)
Lock
	Value
	REAL hero identity
	characters/monarch REAL face v5 + REAL body v2 (Drive IDs 1YTschdKJjpmsl4jIgC15y8yjek0zf1-M, 177bFsA2oy--XSZOqbRycGieIbYJuX8S-)
	STICK hero identity
	stick face v4 + stick body v4 — realistic human face kabhi stickman par nahi
	Wardrobe
	fitted black shirt (top button open) + charcoal blazer, no tie
	Light
	soft key upper-left, teal + amber rims, charcoal backdrop
	Look
	attractive · boss · masculine · fun · hooked gaze
	Aspect
	films/reels: 16:9 ya 9:16/3:4 — H3 ke supported ratios me se chuno, adaptive sirf ref/i2v me
	FPS
	H3 native 24 fps → deliverable 24 fps (WF-05 ka 30 fps project ho to conform karo, re-time nahi)
	Audio
	native 32 kHz stereo; music/soundscape H3 se, ya mute karke WF-05 me apna design
	3. Language — honest limitation
H3 ke stable 11 languages: Arabic, Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish. Urdu aur Hindi is list me nahi hain (partial support). Is liye:


* Dialogue critical ho to pehle ek 4–5 s test clip me wohi line generate karo, accent/pronunciation sun lo.
* Urdu dialogue script me likho <d>[Urdu] ...</d> — model try karega, magar accent drift ka risk hai.
* Safe default: English dialogue, Roman-Urdu sirf on-screen text ke tor par (ya WF-05 me caption layer se).
4. Ready templates
4.1 Monarch face — talking-head hero shot (Ref2VA, 5 s, 9:16)
subject_definitions:


<Subject 1> is the man in <Picture 1>, <Picture 2> and <Picture 3>: late-20s South Asian man, thick swept-back


black hair with volume at the crown, long side locks in front of the ears, light beard along the jaw, straight


nose, wearing a fitted black shirt with the top button open and a charcoal blazer.


<Picture 1> is the front hero shot of <Subject 1>; <Picture 2> is his three-quarter view; <Picture 3> is his


right profile. <Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1>.


summary:


[single character, direct address] A 5-second vertical close-up of <Subject 1> in a charcoal studio, lit by a


soft key from upper-left with teal and amber rim lights, delivering one short line to camera with a confident


half-smile.


retention_analysis:


<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - same face, hair volume, side locks, beard line, wardrobe and grooming as the three


reference pictures; only expression and head angle change.


<Audio 1>: reference - the target speech follows the timbre and calm pacing of <Audio 1>.


detailed_description:


The target video is in realistic photographic style, vertical 9:16 framing.


[Shot 1] A medium close-up frames <Subject 1> from the chest up, centred against a charcoal backdrop with a


faint teal rim on his left shoulder and a warm amber edge on his right. Soft key light from upper-left models


the cheekbone and the jaw beard. He holds eye contact with the lens, inhales once, and speaks with a low,


assured voice (S1), <d>[Urdu] Main hoon Monarch. Kaam bolta hai.</d> As he finishes, the corner of his mouth


lifts into a slow confident smirk and his chin lowers slightly. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at


slow speed throughout the shot. A single loose strand of hair falls forward across his temple near the end.


overall_soundscape:


A quiet studio room tone with a very low air-conditioning hum; the faint rustle of the blazer collar as his


shoulders settle after the line.


non_diegetic_music:


A sparse, modern trap-orchestral bed at slow tempo: a single detuned 808 sub under a muted cello note, no drums,


fading to silence on the smirk.
4.2 Monarch noir shot (T2VA, 8 s, 16:9)
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action noir, a low-angle wide shot frames a rain-wet


street at 3 a.m. ... (subject, wardrobe, action, camera: "The camera trucks right with small amplitude at slow


speed past a flickering neon sign.") [Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a tight profile close-up ...


overall_soundscape: steady rain on metal awnings, distant tram, footsteps in shallow water, a coat zipper.


non_diegetic_music: solo muted trumpet over a sustained low string drone, slow tempo, ending on an unresolved


minor second.
4.3 Product / style reel (T2VA, 5 s, 9:16) — WF-05 ke saath match
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D CG render, macro product shot, a matte black object rotating on


a reflective obsidian plinth, single hard key light sweeping across its edge, dust motes in the beam. The camera


arcs around the object with small amplitude at slow speed. At 00:03.000 the camera cuts to a full vertical frame


with the object centred as a soft teal gradient blooms behind it.


overall_soundscape: a deep sub-bass swell, a metallic click as the object locks into place, subtle room air.


non_diegetic_music: minimal electronic pulse, 90 BPM, one filtered saw chord that opens up at the cut.
5. Monarch shot-list rules
1. 4–15 s per shot. 10 s se lamba shot likhna aasan hai magar ek shot me ek hi dramatic beat rakho.
2. Har shot ek beat. Cut ke andar naya information (subject/space/state/time) hona chahiye, sirf zoom nahi.
3. Same reference set har shot me (3–4 images). Naya angle chahiye to naya image add karo, prompt badal ke ummeed na rakho.
4. Audio decide karo pehle: H3 ka native audio chahiye, ya silent plate chahiye jo WF-05 me score hoga? Silent plate ke liye non_diegetic_music: none + ambience halka likho.
5. Seed/retry policy: ek shot ke 3 attempts max; phir prompt ya reference badlo (same prompt ko 5 dafa chalane se paisa zaya hota hai).
6. Continuity: shot N ka last frame shot N+1 ka first frame ban sakta hai (FL2VA) — is se cuts seamless ho jate hain aur character drift kam hota hai.
